Translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَخْذُلْنِيْ فِيْهِ لِتَعَرُّضِ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
Translation: O Allah, do not forsake me in it (this day) when I am exposed to Your disobedience
And do not strike me with the whips of Your punishment
And distance me in it from all that incurs Your wrath

Arabic text: بِمَنِّكَ وَأَيَادِيْكَ يَا مُنْتَهَى رَغْبَةِ الرَّاغِبِينَ
Translation: By Your favor and Your support, O ultimate goal of those who desire
